parts.text: {"units":[{"kind":"permission","meaning":"Permits an employee to be on non-FMLA leave when reaching the 12-month eligibility threshold, and classifies any subsequent portion of leave taken for an FMLA-qualifying reason after meeting that threshold as FMLA leave, cross-referencing § 825.300(b) for eligibility notice content rules.","quote_ref":"F015","scope_refs":[]}]}
